title: Validation v1
description: config/validation/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F6a): a validation criterion, the evidence in use that a need or a requirement is met (ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 validation): what it validates, the measure, the comparator, the threshold and the window. Its state is derived by scripts/model from the measure (met, not-met, measuring while the window is short, defined while no source is wired), never written.

kind.description: merges-per-day: merges on main's first-parent line per complete UTC day, averaged over the window's days; trailer-rate: the share of merges whose commits carry `trailer`, over the window's merges; model-share: a share scripts/model computes (`name`); incident-count: the incident records (scripts/incident) of kind `incident` opened over the window's days; code-scan: the sleep calls inside a loop in the code under `paths` less `exclude` (globs), the candidates for polling; all-met: how many of the validations `of` are not met, measuring while any is short of data or has no source; run-durations: the `percentile` of the durations in a recorded snapshot of `workflow` (config/validation/runs/: a GitHub workflow's runs by scripts/runs, or `deploy`, the AWS deploy's succeeded builds by scripts/deploy status), measuring while it holds fewer than `min_runs` runs or is older than `max_age_days`; unwired: no source is wired yet (`source` says which).
